{{Conjecture|legends}}
At some point during the early existence of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] and former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Deelguh/Legends|Deelguh]] led a force on a '''raid''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]] in order to acquire the local [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|kyber crystals]]. A [[Space warfare/Legends|battle]] broke out in the planet's [[Atmosphere/Legends|skies]] between Deelguh's and Jedi forces, and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Taradon/Legends|Taradon]] eventually sacrificed [[Gender/Legends|his]] life in order to stop Deelguh by causing a collision of their respective [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]].<ref name="NoP">''[[Nexus of Power]]''</ref>
